reasons.persona_fit: Accurately speaks to small-business owner-operators in Bareni's calm, practical voice without hype, adheres to the no-CTA rule, and respects all persona boundaries.
reasons.clarity: The argument is immediately clear, well-structured, and explains technical governance concepts in plain founder terms without ambiguity.
reasons.actionability: Provides a sharp decision test (cost to reverse vs pause) and a concrete mapping method with three clear decision categories.
reasons.factual_grounding: All claims are grounded; the accounts-payable demo is accurately described with synthetic data and simulated blocked payments rather than real transfers.
